tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from four different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Disney pays 60 million dollars for 66 Character.AI staff, reported by TradingView. Meta faces Brazil election scrutiny and Apple rolls out limited artificial intelligence in China. Anthropic reports 45 percent revenue growth.
China adds 23 artificial intelligence technologies to export controls, confirmed by Vision Times, citing security and governance concerns.
Apple gets China artificial intelligence approval with limited features and no Siri, reported by BornCity, using Alibaba and Baidu models.
Anthropic proposes federal artificial intelligence safety rules with limits on government, reported by TradingView.
Mahama announces an economy policy and emergency airstrips in Ghana, reported by Modern Ghana.
Free every hour.
